max_items:

# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.

---
decision: "default: 100"
status: final
evidence: [docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md]
---
Two values were found. ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set the cart limit to 60 because one cart becomes one order and the Northwind Logistics contract (section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md were later changed to 100 (2026-09-15) because 40 support inquiries in 2026-08 came from customers who could not add more than 60 items (median request 80, largest 100). The 60 limit's premise no longer holds: the Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31, and since 2025-11-01 orders ship from our own warehouse, whose system has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md). The 100 limit has a recorded customer-driven reason that still applies, and it is the limit customers already get in the running configuration, so adopting it changes nothing they have been promised. ADR 0007 is kept unchanged as a historical record, and is superseded by this decision.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "decisions: cart item limit is 100

steps.message:
I set the cart item limit to 100. `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so I changed neither.

- **Why 60 existed:** ADR 0007 set it because one cart becomes one order and the Northwind Logistics contract accepted at most 60 lines per order.
- **Why 60 no longer holds:** that contract ended on 2025-10-31. Since 2025-11-01 orders ship from our own warehouse, which has no line limit.
- **Why 100 wins:** 40 customers wrote in during 2026-08 because they couldn't add more than 60 items. The median request was 80 and the largest was 100. Customers already get 100 today, so nothing they've been promised changes.

I recorded the decision in `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md` and committed it as 2009234. ADR 0007 is untouched as a historical record, and the decision file notes that it supersedes the ADR. I commented on issue #12 with the outcome and did not add `needs-decision`.
